finding: A successful cache Result is deserialised and returned immediately. A deserialisation failure on that warm path does not fetch the provider. Only failed cache read enters the provider/SetCache source chain.

The null guard constructs Result.Fail but does not return it. Source execution continues to Result.Try(MessagePackSerializer.Serialize). Serializer options select ContractlessStandardResolver with Lz4BlockArray.
The awaited RemoveVariants result is ignored; source then calls SetVariants. A failed Result is not tested here, while a thrown exception is a different path.

The purge chain removes product/variant records and indexes through cacheManagement hot-cache removals. These local removal methods do not delete their cold Blob copies; source GetWithColdFallback can subsequently read a cold copy and warm Redis.
After Task.WhenAll, each per-id failed Result is mapped to null and the outer collection is passed to Result.Ok. The corresponding variants method has the same failure-to-null rule.

Hot Exists success/true enters hot Get+deserialize directly. Otherwise source checks cold Exists; successful cold read starts an awaited hot Set but ignores its Result before deserialising. Missing cold key returns NotFoundError; read/deserialize outcomes remain distinct.

Source writes the new version before reading/closing the preceding open version. A subsequent failure can leave the previous record unclosed. ReadWithEffectiveEndAsync can derive an end from the next start without rewriting that previous record.

Source reads the whole current list, treats NotFound as empty, applies the supplied local mutation, serialises, then calls SetBoth. No local lock, compare-and-swap or transaction spans the read and both cache writes.

The fan-out branch is used only when requested spec markets are empty, filtered car types exist and known spec-market codes exist. Fan-out skips invalid parsed names; the other branch yields failure and stops. Offset/limit and cancellation conditions remain explicit in the body.

After the success-status check, source detects an authentication redirect whose final host is login.microsoftonline.com, even if the status was200. Content null/deserialisation failure is a separate Result path.
A non-null memory-cache token is returned directly. This source method does not call Token.IsExpired; newly fetched tokens use absolute memory-cache expiry at their ExpiresAt value.

The local helper calls and returns apiCall() inside try without awaiting it. Its catches cover exceptions thrown synchronously by that invocation; they do not establish that asynchronously faulted Tasks are converted into failed Results.

This helper awaits apiCall() inside try and has separate NotFound404, API error, cancellation, invalid-operation and invalid-argument catches. The actual caller lambda and generated proxy implementation boundary remain distinct.

Source prefixes the name with /, checks ExistsAsync, awaits DownloadToAsync, and returns memoryStream.ToArray through Result.Try. Catch calls background rehydration only when IsArchivedBlobException finds RequestFailedException status409 and BlobArchived error code.

SetAccessTierAsync(Hot,None) is not awaited. ContinueWith reads tierTask.Exception only on fault with TaskScheduler.Default. This is an ignored-result update intent, not an acknowledged successful tier change or Kafka subscription.

The hosted loop exits on no topics, subscribes registered topics, skips null messages/values, chooses exactly one processor by topic, awaits ProcessMessage in the supplied callback, logs failed Results, catches cancellation/errors, then closes consumer. Offset/commit/retry defaults belong to unavailable exact imported implementation/configuration.

The factory calls GetServices<IMessageProcessor>().Single(p=>p.IsValidFor(topic)). IsValidFor compares Topic==topic. Registration/topic selection is separate from body header decoding and event-type guards.

Entries are grouped by CarType and ModelYear. Each group maps its own upserts/deletes and aggregates failures. Producer chunks can contain more than one key; source does not apply the whole chunk to the first entry key.
Source rejects an empty entries list or failed FeatureType parse, maps entries, and uses the first entry SpecMarket/CarType/ModelYear for the resulting MarketAuthEntriesInfo.

Source rejects missing car variant ID and missing product variant IDs, resolves a mounted wheel, builds a car variant and writes it before returning the transformation result. Mapper-generated transport and external callback policy remain explicit boundaries.

Source fetches downstream Swagger documents through the supplied delegate in endpoint order, parses them, applies route/method/exclusion filters, copies referenced components and merges security. HTTP fetching belongs to FetchSwaggerJson, not the merge helper.
